run_a2c_training: run the A2C reinforcement learning training loop with multi-process environment agents on CartPole
create_ProbAgent: create a ProbAgent neural network that outputs action probabilities from environment observations
create_CriticAgent: create a CriticAgent neural network that estimates state values from environment observations
create_ActionAgent: create an ActionAgent that samples actions stochastically or greedily from action probabilities
run_main_entry: run the main entry point that spawns multi-process workers and starts A2C training via Hydra config
